summary: This plugin provides conversational proteomics analysis in DeepSeek Harness, taking user data files and guided inputs to run normalization, PCA, batch correction, differential analysis, enrichment analyses, and return summarized interpretation outputs.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The README clearly identifies the plugin as a DeepSeek Harness tool for end-to-end proteomics data analysis: it takes user-provided expression and sample information, executes a defined sequence of statistical and enrichment analyses, and returns summaries plus figures and interpretation outputs. This aligns primarily with data processing and workflow automation within the platform rather than code generation, UI theming, or collaboration features.
